messages:
lena_ae: Heads up 12: Enterprise POC with NovaNet showing median TTFT ~1.1s on single-turn prompts; expected ~200-300ms. They9re using hosted in eu-west-1, model: redwood-compat-13b, avg prompt 40 tokens, context ~250 tokens, ~30 concurrent connections. Also sporadic 429s during short bursts. Need triage before Friday exec demo. cc @omar_se @raj_sre

omar_se: Can you paste one curl and an example 429 response? Also have they done any explicit warmup or are conversations keyed uniquely per user?

lena_ae: Sample curl in paste: https://paste.example.com/novanet-poc (sanitized). 429 body: {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":10}. No explicit warmup; front-end opens new conversation ids per session.

nina_ml: Likely causes: 1) KV-prefix cache not being effective because convo IDs differ per client, 2) batching induced queueing because long-context requests are mixed with short ones, increasing queue_wait_ms.

nina_ml: Quick test: run prefix warmup (same convo key) and measure delta. Also check runtime metrics: avg_batch_size, queue_wait_ms, token_gen_ms. If queue_wait_ms >> token_gen_ms, batching is harming TTFT.

omar_se: I can pull batch metrics. Raj, any infra events in eu-west-1?

raj_sre: There was a brief shard reschedule at 02:40 UTC that created extra queueing for 5-6 minutes. Not seeing persistent failures. For 429s, looks like API gateway per-account throttle. I can temporarily increase their burst quota for the POC window.

infra_bot: quota-bot: "Temporary quota increase for account novanet applied: 1500 r/min until 2026-03-27T12:00:00Z"

lena_ae: After quota bump we still see p50 drop to ~420ms but p95 ~900ms. 429s lower but still appear when client spikes without smoothing.

omar_se: Share X-Redwood-Route header from a 429 so we can confirm layer. Also confirm shard route for improved telemetry.

lena_ae: Example header: X-Redwood-Route: eu-west-1-hst-02. 429 looks gateway-sourced.

raj_sre: Confirmed gateway throttle. Next steps: (1) advise client to implement token-bucket smoothing in front-end; (2) we can enable prefix_kv for their account to help warm cache; (3) reduce max_batch_size for their route to lower queueing. I9ll push the config now.

omar_se: After config change, I9ll run synthetic load: 30 clients, 100 reqs each, short prompts. Nina, please compare batch stats pre/post.

nina_ml: Will do. Also recommend considering a quantized variant for lower per-token latency if quality OK. For this workload a smaller batch size (2-4) often reduces TTFT.

kevin_sec: NovaNet asked about log retention and encryption. They require 90-day logs and CMK for storage. Is that doable for a hosted POC?

raj_sre: CMK support can be toggled for the account after a quick compliance review; 90-day retention is fine as a POC setting. I9ll open infra ticket and enable CMK when approved.

liz_devex: I9ll prepare a POC runbook: warmup script, client smoothing example, and a cost estimate for burst vs dedicated. Also include a small curl-based warmup sample.

omar_se: Warmup sample (run 6x per shard):

for i in 1..6; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-compat-13b","prompt":"warmup","convo_key":"novanet-warmup"}'
  sleep 0.2
done

raj_sre: I pushed prefix_kv=true and max_batch_size=3 for their route. Please re-run load test.

lena_ae: Re-ran at 09:15. Results: median ~310ms, p95 ~580ms. 429s only when front-end sent >1.2k r/min bursts.

omar_se: Good. For remaining 429s we should either: (A) request a higher soft quota during the demo window, or (B) recommend Dedicated for predictable peak capacity. I'll raise support ticket to bump soft limit for the demo.

kevin_sec: I9ll start the security questionnaire. Need confirmation: are logs stored in our region for EU customers only? Also confirm CMK workflow (customer provides key vs we generate CMK and grant access).

raj_sre: We store logs in the customer's region by default when they opt-in. For CMK we support customer-provided keys (bring-your-own-key) for hosted POC after legal approval; infra ticket started.

liz_devex: Pricing note: short spike pricing in hosted assumes pay-as-you-go; for a single 30m spike to 5k r/min cost is higher than a week-long dedicated buffer. I9ll put numbers in the doc once I have tokens/resp average.

lena_ae: Client wanted a quick estimate: if spike is 5k r/min for 30m with avg 200 tokens output, what9s rough hosted delta vs 1-week dedicated buffer?

liz_devex: DM with numbers. Preview: Hosted spike ~+$600 for the 30m window (depends on token pricing), Dedicated reserved buffer reduces marginal cost ~50-70% depending on commitment.

omar_se: Action items: 1) Raj: infra tickets for CMK + soft quota bump (SUP-9910) 2) Nina & Omar: finalize warmup script and batch tuning, post runbook 3) Liz: pricing delta and runbook section 4) Kevin: security questionnaire draft. Meeting scheduled Thu 11am CET to review.

lena_ae: Thanks all 10: will update the customer and prep demo with smoothing guidance. :thumbsup:
